sources.note: Record + second-hand only: the publisher description lists ten parts including a 语言 (language) part; the zh.wikipedia article 子君语, whose sole reference is this book, reproduces a sound-system sketch with initials, finals (noting lax vowel quality under the 33 tone and tense quality under the 21 tone) and six tones: 高平调 55, 全降调 51, 中平调 33, 中高调 35, 短降调 31, 次低降调 21. Likely therefore to contain the fullest printed Chinese-language phonology of Zijun speech with a 6-tone inventory (cf. Lama 2012's 7-tone analysis 55 (44) 33 22 53 21 25 and the 官渡区志 1999 6-tone count). Not seen directly.
